subject: math

objective.text: Solve word problems about grams, kilograms, liters and milliliters. Use adding, subtracting, multiplying or dividing.

explanations.title: Make a ten
explanations.text: For 34 plus 126, move 4 to the 126 to make 130. Then 130 plus 30 equals 160.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 1 (S: 126 grams is almost 130 grams...)

explanations.title: Choose the operation
explanations.text: Ask: are we joining, taking away, finding equal groups, or sharing? That tells you to add, subtract, multiply or divide.

explanations.title: Keep the same unit
explanations.text: All the numbers in a problem use the same unit, like grams or liters. Your answer uses that unit too.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective (given in the same units)

examples.title: Mouse and hamster
examples.text: The mouse weighs 34 grams. The hamster weighs 126 grams more. 34 plus 126 equals 160 grams.

examples.title: Fish bowls
examples.text: 36 liters, 4 liters in each bowl. 36 divided by 4 equals 9 bowls.

questions.text: What number is halfway between 80 and 90?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Halfway on the Number Line (80 and 90)

questions.text: A 1 liter beaker has 2 equal parts. Each part is how many milliliters?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Read a Beaker (2 equal parts, 500 mL)

questions.text: A mouse weighs 34 grams. A hamster weighs 126 grams more. How much does the hamster weigh?
Robert's tool crate weighs 12 kilograms. He takes out the power tools. Now it weighs 4 kilograms. How much do the power tools weigh?
A pitcher of shaved ice needs 5 milliliters of coloring. How much do 9 pitchers need?
A tank has 36 liters of water. Each fish bowl holds 4 liters. How many bowls can be filled?
9 kilograms of walnuts cost 36 dollars. How much does 1 kilogram cost?
An orange and a mango weigh 637 grams together. The orange weighs 385 grams. What does the mango weigh?

source_ref.section: Concept Development (take apart with addend unknown)

questions.text: A rabbit weighs 892 grams. A guinea pig weighs 736 grams. How much more does the rabbit weigh?
Jack measures 250 milliliters of water. Angie measures double that. How much does Angie measure?
A frozen turkey weighs about 5 kilograms. The chef orders 45 kilograms. About how many turkeys is that?
A recipe needs 300 milliliters of milk. Sara triples the recipe. How much milk does she need?
Marian fills 3 buckets of 4 liters each. She still has 2 liters left. What is the capacity of her container?
A horse and rider weigh 729 kilograms. The horse weighs 625 kilograms. How much does the rider weigh?
Dwight has 48 kilograms of fertilizer. Each garden bed needs 6 kilograms. How many beds can he fertilize?
Marian's problem has two steps. Why is it harder than a one-step problem?
